mapper.select: SELECT lectures.id, courses.code AS courseCode, courses.name AS courseName, courses.credits, users.name AS professorName, lectures.room, lectures.schedule, lectures.capacity, lectures.year, lectures.semester FROM lectures JOIN courses ON lectures.course_id = courses.id JOIN users ON lectures.professor_id = users.id ORDER BY lectures.year DESC, lectures.semester DESC, courses.name ASC
